notes: Single source of truth for biome families. Consumers: tools/landmark-factory (landmarks, props, terrain_piece), tools/creature-factory (palette.creature), prototypes/world-lab galaxy.ts (terrain_kinds, marker, growth_hero, catastrophe, palette.night).
Derived fields (creature contrast_vs_ground, terrain_kinds[].tint or tint_hsl_offset) are recomputed by assets/biomes/validate_catalog.py; edit either side and run --fix.
The seven shipped families keep their asset ids and landmark file names from assets/landmarks/manifest.json byte for byte.

conventions.contrast: WCAG relative-luminance ratio (L1+0.05)/(L2+0.05); creature body colours must be >= 1.4 against palette.ground
conventions.tint_hsl_offset: hue in degrees (-180..180), saturation and lightness as absolute deltas in 0..1; tint = ground shifted by the offset
conventions.density: decor count for a reference topic cell of angular radius 0.24 rad on the 70-unit planet (matches galaxy.ts)

profiles.gentle: soft slope down to a neighbour (shore)
profiles.recessed_water: bowl below base; fill = water | lava | ice | none
profiles.terrace: raised flat plateau with a rim step

conventions.growth_bands: percent of course progress: 0, 25, 50, 75, 100; height_m_by_band is the hero's world height (before PROP_SCALE)
conventions.night: driven by the page colour scheme: prefers-color-scheme dark = night. palette.night overrides sky/fog/lamp/window and adds family extras
